data_quality:
Counts may differ from previous editions due to further development of data, rounding, late reporting or corrections.

As of September 2019, multiple counting of a small number of crashes has been adjusted. Crash counts for years 2013 or later may be slightly lower than previously published.

Geocode information such as Road Location Description, Latitude and Longitude are approximate and are only assigned to crashes where sufficient location information was available to determine a latitude and longitude. Crashes with insufficient location information do not have geocode information and are blank.
license_title: Open Data Licence for ICBC Information
lineage_statement:
Data captured as of 04-Apr-2020

ICBC data is available by late spring/early summer of the following year (i.e., spring 2020 for 2019 data). The source is ICBC’s Enterprise Data Warehouse.

Crashes that occurred outside of B.C. have been excluded.

Data includes incidents that occurred in parking lots or involved parked vehicles.

resources.supplemental_info:
ICBC Reported Crashes dataset includes the following data fields:
- Crash Count
- Crash Severity
- Cross Street Full Name
- Cyclist Flag
- Date of Loss Year
- Day of Week
- Derived Crash Configuration
- Heavy Vehicle Flag
- Intersection Crash
- Latitude
- Longitude
- Mid Block Crash
- Month of Year
- Motorcycle Flag
- Municipality Name
- Municipality with Boundary
- Parking Lot Flag
- Pedestrian Flag
- Region
- Road Location Description
- Street Full Name
- Time Category
